actions.text: The page loads health issues from the health API.
The page loads disk space information from the diskspace API.
The page loads system status for the About section, and refetches it when the section is shown.
For indexer-related health issues, a 'Test All' button runs the test-all call for indexers and spins while it runs.
For download-client-related health issues, a 'Test All' button runs the test-all call for download clients and spins while it runs.
Each health row has a wiki button ('Read the Wiki for more information') linking to the item's wiki URL.

rules.text: Disk usage is 100 minus free/total as a percentage; the bar is danger above 90%, warning above 80%, otherwise primary.
Test All for indexers appears only for sources IndexerStatusCheck and IndexerLongTermStatusCheck; for download clients only for DownloadClientCheck and DownloadClientStatusCheck.
Package Version is shown only when present, using package author text when an author exists. The .NET version row shows only for .NET Core, and Docker 'Yes' only when containerized.
A test-all response of status 400 with an array body is treated as test results rather than an error.
API requests send the API key and a Sonarr client header.

shows.text: The page is titled Status under the System heading and has four sections: Health, Disk Space, About and More Info.
The Health section shows a loading indicator while loading, and next to the legend while fetching for the first time.
When health data has loaded and there are no issues, the Health section shows 'No issues with your configuration'.

When there are health issues, they are listed in a table with an icon for the type, the message, and action buttons. An info alert about health messages with a link to /system/logs/files appears below the table.
Each health row's icon is red/danger for type 'error', info for 'notice', and warning for 'warning' or any other type. The icon tooltip is the title-cased type.

Each health row has a Settings or other shortcut button depending on the source: indexer checks go to /settings/indexers, download client and import mechanism checks to /settings/downloadclients, notification status to /settings/connect, root folder check to /serieseditor (Series Editor), update check to /system/updates (Updates). Other sources show no shortcut.
The Disk Space section shows a loading indicator while fetching, otherwise a table of disks with path (plus label in parentheses when present), free space, total space and a usage progress bar.
The About section lists Version, Package Version, .NET version, Docker, Database (title-cased type and version), Database Migration, App Data Directory, Startup Directory, Mode and Uptime.
Uptime is shown as a time span (days plus hh:mm:ss) that updates every second; hovering shows the formatted start date and time including seconds.

The More Info section lists links: Home page sonarr.tv, Wiki wiki.servarr.com/sonarr, Forums forums.sonarr.tv, Twitter @sonarrtv, Discord discord.sonarr.tv, IRC (irc.libera.chat/#sonarr and web chat), Donations sonarr.tv/donate, Source github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr, and Feature requests (forums and GitHub issues).
